information_flow: The founder receives all six common inputs and may use the anchor only as non-authoritative evidence, then emits one complete executable state without anchor-relative edit provenance. The successor immediately consumes that state plus listed public obligations; it has no anchor_policy edge, owns the rebased state as its sole executable ancestry, and emits the sole outward policy.
name: Executable Genesis Rebase with Anchor-Blind Successor
organization: Two-call single-lineage succession in which an executable genesis rebase, rather than review or role fission, transfers sole constructive authority.

calls.objective: Use the common public evidence to materialize one complete contract-compliant executable policy state as a new lineage root. Give the anchor no source, edit, or fallback authority, and carry no anchor-relative edit ledger, review record, alternatives, or parameter choices into the handoff.

Treat the immediately preceding executable state as the sole policy ancestry. Using only the listed public obligations, exercise whole-state constructive authority and emit one complete contract-compliant policy without anchor-relative comparison, reviewer verdicts, delta replay, rollback, compression, alternatives, or hidden evidence.
